Threat-model a SaaS startup where engineers use ChatGPT daily. List top 3 realistic data-leak paths.

Pasting source or secrets into a public GenAI chatbot is a data-loss path: content leaves the enterprise boundary, the vendor may retain or train on prompts depending on contract, and Shadow IT bypasses DLP that only inspects email, USB, or web-upload MIME types. Realistic leak paths for a SaaS team using ChatGPT daily include (1) paste of secrets and code into GenAI, (2) unsanctioned SaaS file uploads, (3) endpoint malware or a camera / shoulder-surf of the screen. Controls: browser DLP (GenGuard), approved enterprise GenAI with logging, secret scanning, and visual DLP (VisionX).

Summarize Trustity Axiom edge SMB and DNS for a security operator.

Trustity Axiom is edge SMB and DNS security: an inline SMB reverse proxy and policy-driven DNS nodes. It can run air-gap capable and does not require an endpoint agent on every device for this path, so it can cover IoT and BYOD that lack TAO. Policy-driven DNS at the edge reduces malware callback risk by blocking known-bad or DGA-like domains centrally. Axiom complements TAO endpoint controls; it is a portfolio product licensed separately from the Cloud Portal.
